tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khrid kyi snying po gnas lugs gcer mthong gi man ngag bzhugs so// swa sti/ lam 'bras la sogs pa'i nges don gyi 'khrid zab mo thob kyang ji bzhin nyams len mi shes pa rnams kyis nges don la sems 'jog tshul ni stan bde bar 'khod de/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams drag tu bsam ste/ sems 'dar yed ma byung bar du bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad blo yul du byas nas pha mar thag bcad/ da lta'i dgra gnyen chags sdang sogs 'khrul snang du thag bcad de/ byams snying rjes kun nas blangs te/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi blo dang 'dres nges yang yang bsgom/ de nas spyi bor bla ma bsgom la gsol ba drag tu btab nas rang la thim par bsam nas rang lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ lus mi 'gul ba/ mig gi rdzi ma mi 'khrab pa/ dmigs rten gsal ba/ dmigs rten mi g.yo ba sogs kyis sems la zhi gnas kyis gnas cha btsal te/ de yang dang por sgrim/ bar du slod/ mthar res 'jog tu bzhag de ltar byas pa'i sems la cung zad gnas cha rnyed nas/ de nas lhag mthong ni/ phyi nang 'khor 'das snod bcud phung khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad cha dang dbang phyug la sogs pa'i byas pa yang ma yin zhing nyan thos sde gnyis la sogs pa'i 'dod pa phyi rol rdul phran la sogs pa don la grub pa med cing / mdor na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'o snyam du thag gcad la 'dzin med du mnyam par bzhag 'o na spros bral yin na 'khor 'das sogs sna tshogs su snang ba 'di ci yin snyam na/ thog ma med pa nas rang sems 'khrul pa'i bag chags goms pa'i dbang las byung ba dper na rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par spu tsam yang med par thag bcad de snang ba bden med rmi lam lta bu/

snang tsam ma 'gag pa snang stong sgyu mar shes par byas la/ snang sems dbyer med ro gcig pa mar la mar zhag dang chu la chu bzhag pa'i tshul du byas nas 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ong pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da ltar ba la rtsis gdab mi bya bar spros pa thams cad sbad kyis bcad la mnyam par bzhag rtogs bya ni ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir mthong ba bya ba dang byed pa ma grub pa'o/ /lang gshegs las/ ji ltar ral gri rang so dang / /ji ltar mdzub mos rang rtse la/ /mi gcod rig par mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin sems kyi sems mi mthong / /zhes gsung so/ /mtshan nyid ni/ de kho nar sems la/ mtshan gzhi ma grub pa'i de la brten pa'i mtshan nyid ma grub pa'o/ /skye med rin po che'i mdzod las/ mtshan gzhi mo bsham mtshan nyid ni/ /yi ge spros dang bral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar blta ba'i gnas lugs kyi mtshan nyid brjod bral blo 'das su nges shing 'drongs nges ma byung bar du yang bsam mnos thag bcad cing bsgom/ thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams dang ma bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i blo sngon du btang nas/ gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dang / de ltar lta ba la blo kha phyogs pa tsam la'ang dge ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyur cig snyam du bsam nas/ ngag tu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba smon lam btab/ thun mtshams rnams su sems ma yengs ba dang / sgyu ma byed pa dag gi gzugs sprul nas sogs gang tu brjod cing don bsam la dge ba'i las la brtson par bya'o/ /'di yang bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'khrid kyi snying po gnas lugs gcer mthong gi man ngag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
